Some entrances don't welcome you — they enchant you.

Built around a waterfall

Ziora By The Falls sits beside a tiered waterfall built into stone and bamboo — the reason the space exists at all. Palms line the path in, string-lit lanterns replace ceiling light after dark, and the sound of moving water carries into every seat.

The kitchen moves across cuisines without losing its own voice: wood-fired breads, hand-rolled sushi, ramen, and a full Jain menu prepared with the same care as everything else.
